title: OTEL Tracing Opt-In Env Vars: OTEL_LOG_USER_PROMPTS, OTEL_LOG_TOOL_DETAILS, OTEL_LOG_TOOL_CONTENT (v2.1.101)
description: Claude Code's beta OTEL (OpenTelemetry) tracing now honors three new opt-in env vars that control what sensitive data is included in trace spans. By default, user prompt text and tool content are redacted from spans. Setting OTEL_LOG_USER_PROMPTS=1 includes prompt text, OTEL_LOG_TOOL_CONTENT=1 includes tool invocation content, and OTEL_LOG_TOOL_DETAILS=1 includes detailed tool metadata. Additionally, v2.1.101 adds W3C TRACEPARENT env var to Bash subprocesses when OTEL tracing is enabled, allowing child-process spans to correctly parent to the Claude Code trace tree. Together these enable full distributed tracing of Claude Code sessions for debugging and cost analysis in observability pipelines. A community repo (ColeMurray/claude-code-otel) with guidance already exists. Relevant for heartbeat/pipeline cost monitoring.

evaluation.reasoning: Official Anthropic feature (v2.1.101) with community quickstart (ColeMurray/claude-code-otel). Novel capability: full distributed tracing of Claude Code sessions including subagent spans, Bash subprocess spans, and MCP tool invocations. Token efficiency benefit is indirect: enables identifying which heartbeat phases, subagents, or MCP tools consume disproportionate context. Capability expansion 75: genuinely novel — no equivalent in current monitoring stack. Integration complexity 60: requires OTLP endpoint setup, CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_TELEMETRY=1, and running an OTEL collector. Maintenance burden 60: collector process needs to stay up. Research: check if ColeMurray/claude-code-otel has a local-only quickstart (e.g., OTLP→local file), determine whether this integrates with the existing agent-event-bus monitoring pipeline, and estimate the overhead cost.
research_questions: Does CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_TELEMETRY=1 need to be set alongside the OTEL_LOG_* vars for tracing to work?
What OTLP endpoint configuration is needed? Does ColeMurray/claude-code-otel provide a local-only (no external service) quickstart?
Can OTEL trace data be written to a local file or SQLite without running a full collector stack?
Integration path with the agent-event-bus: can trace spans be published to the event bus for analysis?
Performance overhead of tracing enabled for every heartbeat/cron run?
